To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“ERP systems are a strategic tool for organizations to improve their performance, however, the successful implementation of ERP system depends on the critical success factors”.

the main benefits that ERP systems bring to the organizations are the integration of the business processes, reduction of the cycle time, reduction of costs, improvement in customer satisfaction, and improvement in the supply chain.

“the critical success factors in ERP implementations are: Top management support, having an appropriate business plan and a clear vision, re-engineer business process, effective Project management, User involvement and training, and finally, the use of a good ERP package”.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of critical success factors for ERP implementation and the development of a framework for the successful implementation of ERP system.
the critical success factors in ERP implementations.
the critical success factors that are essential for ERP implementation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ERP systems have brought many benefits to the organizations, but it is not an easy task to achieve the full potential of the systems.
ERP systems are complex and challenging to implement.
there is no single critical success factor for ERP implementation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the success of an ERP system implementation depends on the ability of the organizations to identify their business needs and to develop the right strategy to achieve the business objectives.
the implementation of ERP systems is a challenging task.
the success factors are interrelated and the implementation of ERP systems should be treated as a holistic project.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ERP system is a strategic decision and it should be implemented with the right approach and the right mindset.
the critical success factors are not the same for all organizations.
ERP systems are a strategic business investment that can be a major contributor to an organization’s success, provided that the critical success factors are addressed.
